{{Quote|They mounted an ''ultrasonic disruptor'' in the tank? Clever... Its high-pitched broadcast was too high for us to hear but triggered our most ''basic instincts''&hellip; leaving us terrified!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="The Fear Architects">{{TCWComicCite|6.32|The Fear Architects}}</ref>}}
The '''ultrasonic disruptor''', colloquially known as the '''fear emitter''', was a small device that could be used to broadcast high-pitched frequencies, triggering different physical and emotional responses in [[Species/Legends|species]] such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] sent a detachment of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to the [[Gyndine moon|moon of Gyndine]] and had them mount ultrasonic disruptors in their [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], for use [[Battle of the Gyndine moon|against]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces there. The disruptors were programmed to trigger fear-related responses in the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], thereby rendering them easily defeated.
